page.notes: The Greek words in the text (ραγματεύσασθε, Διατάγεας, φονλὼ Ἀποστολικὼ) and the phrase "ex quibusdam" are reproduced from a low-resolution scan and may contain errors; the Greek "ἕως ἔρχομαι" and the Greek heading fragments are doubtful.
